issues.description: Packetization path treats all bytes payloads as PCM audio, not just audio frames.
issues.detail: _write_frame buffers any bytes payload into _audio_send_buffer whenever fixed_audio_packet_size is set, with no frame-type gating. Any serializer emitting non-audio bytes (control payloads, headers) gets chopped into PCM-sized chunks and corrupted. Gate on AudioRawFrame or check frame.format before treating payload as PCM.

issues.description: Real-time pacing is claimed but the send loop has no clock-based gating.
issues.detail: The changelog promises 'real-time pacing,' but _write_frame drains the buffer in a tight while loop emitting packets back-to-back with no link to _next_send_time or wall-clock. Either implement actual pacing tied to _send_interval, or rename the feature to fixed packet framing and correct the description.

issues.description: Buffer residue is never flushed on stream end or disconnect.
issues.detail: On disconnect, StopFrame, or end-of-stream, the residual _audio_send_buffer (0 to packet_bytes-1 bytes) is silently discarded. The postcondition 'all serialized audio is sent' fails. Either pad-and-flush the tail on terminal events or document the truncation contract explicitly.

issues.description: DTMF deserialization accepts two undocumented message shapes.
issues.detail: deserialize() tries message['digit'] then message['dtmf']['digit'] with no spec citation. This is defensive coding around protocol uncertainty. Pick the documented Vonage shape, parse only that, and reject or log-and-drop the other. 'Try both' hides protocol drift and survives forever.

issues.description: PCM16 format is asserted in comments but never enforced.
issues.detail: Comments claim 16-bit linear PCM and fixed_audio_packet_size is coupled to sample width/rate only by folklore. Nothing checks frame.format, sample width, or that packet_size is a multiple of (sample_width * num_channels). A misconfigured size yields half-sample tearing at every boundary. Add an assert or precondition check.

issues.description: Rename from audio_packet_bytes to fixed_audio_packet_size is a silent breaking change.
issues.detail: The param is on a public dataclass with Optional default None, so existing users of audio_packet_bytes silently lose packetization with no error, just wrong behavior. Either keep a deprecated alias for one release or clearly flag the break in the changelog's breaking-changes section.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The Vonage serializer is reasonably shaped, but the FastAPI transport's new fixed-packet path has three correctness concerns all three reviewers raised: it treats every bytes payload as PCM (will corrupt non-audio binary frames), it advertises 'real-time pacing' that the code does not implement, and the buffer tail is never flushed on stream end. Secondary issues include unenforced PCM16 assumptions, a guessy two-shape DTMF parser, and a silent param rename. Fix the gating, decide the DTMF schema, flush the tail, and either implement pacing or rename the knob.
